description: This file defines the KeycloakService class, which provides methods to interact with the Keycloak identity management system, including fetching public keys, obtaining access tokens, creating users, and managing user credentials.

classes.name: KeycloakService
classes.description: A service class for interacting with the Keycloak identity provider, handling tasks such as user creation, token retrieval, and MFA enablement.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the service with a logger and application configuration, setting up the keycloak configuration settings.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a configured Guzzle HTTP client instance.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Fetches the realm information from Keycloak and extracts the public key in PEM format.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Performs a client credentials grant to retrieve an access token from Keycloak.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user in Keycloak with provided user details and password, returning the new user ID.

methods.name: getUserCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves credentials information for a specified user.

methods.name: enableMfa
methods.description: Enables MFA for a user by requiring TOTP configuration.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Requires the user to update their password.

methods.name: requireAction
methods.description: Performs a specific required action (like MFA setup or password update) for a user.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Fetches user information based on email; note: currently no return statement.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user from Keycloak based on their subject ID.
